description: Share of default-branch test runs that pass, fleet-wide, over the daily delivery.tests.* counts posted by kpi/test_health.py (RC1-467). Baseline at creation: 100% pass over 7,412 events in 3 days; 99%/30d is a conservative floor, to be ratcheted from a full window of data. Skips sit in neither number: a skip is a decision, not an outcome. Deliberately not tagged service:* — repo-level test health belongs to the fleet, not to any one runtime service, so it does not answer the Has-an-SLO rule for anyone.
name: Fleet test health
